statement: pdftotext defaults toward reading-order text while -layout instead tries to preserve physical layout.
actakit_implication: Use plain extraction first; request layout mode only for a specific downstream need.

statement: pdftotext can emit word/block/line bounding boxes via -bbox, -bbox-layout and -tsv.
actakit_implication: A deterministic PDF rung can preserve coordinate evidence without invoking OCR or AI.

statement: Raw content-stream order is explicitly discouraged; layout/reading-order choices are heuristic rather than universal truth.
actakit_implication: ActaKit must record extraction mode/version and assess quality instead of treating one order as authoritative.

statement: Hyphen removal is configurable and therefore can change the textual representation.
actakit_implication: Normalization choices are processor parameters and must be captured in ProcessRun provenance.

statement: A digital-text extractor solves only PDFs with usable text layers; it does not solve image-only or badly encoded pages.
actakit_implication: Make pdftotext D1, not the universal PDF processor; quality failure escalates.
